mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_pv_station_status ( external_system_id, sample_time, energy_generation_wh, power_generation_w, energy_consumption_wh, power_consumption_w, normalised_output, temperature_c, voltage_v, raw_payload, fetched_at ) VALUES ( #{status.externalSystemId}, #{status.sampleTime}, #{status.energyGenerationWh}, #{status.powerGenerationW}, #{status.energyConsumptionWh}, #{status.powerConsumptionW}, #{status.normalisedOutput}, #{status.temperatureC}, #{status.voltageV}, #{status.rawPayload}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE energy_generation_wh = VALUES(energy_generation_wh), power_generation_w = VALUES(power_generation_w), energy_consumption_wh = VALUES(energy_consumption_wh), power_consumption_w = VALUES(power_consumption_w), normalised_output = VALUES(normalised_output), temperature_c = VALUES(temperature_c), voltage_v = VALUES(voltage_v), raw_payload = VALUES(raw_payload), fetched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
